businesses.business: Retail supply chain software and services

offering_description.value: SPS Commerce sells supply chain software to retailers, brands, suppliers, manufacturers, distributors and logistics providers. Its shared network connects trading partners to exchange data, automate orders and purchasing, analyze sales and inventory, and recover retail deductions and marketplace reimbursements. It also offers marketplace advertising tools and handles trading partner onboarding and EDI testing.

quotes.quote: SPS Commerce helps suppliers, manufacturers, retailers, distributors and logistics providers, work better together through a shared network that understands how trading relationships actually operate. Instead of managing integrations, chasing exceptions, or rebuilding rules for every partner, companies rely on the SPS Network to coordinate the data, workflows, and decisions that keep supply chains moving.

Whether you’re fulfilling orders, sharing product information, recovering revenue, onboarding partners, or managing inbound materials, the network does the work once, so your team doesn’t have to do it again and again.
